test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 5 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) and complete the given series?

MCRV, PFQU, ?, VLOS, YONR
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 
The pattern followed in the given codes is:
 First two alphabets are increased to 3 positional values.

 Last two alphabets are decreased to 1 positional value.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d8dae60f59e06de68861c70d70d248a71deb96f1b8a669d59c3cbb435268797.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
